description: This file defines the LeaveRequestService class, which manages leave request workflows, status changes, and related business logic within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for changing leave statuses, retrieving allowed workflows, and handling detailed leave request data.

classes.name: LeaveRequestService
classes.description: Service class managing leave request workflows, status transitions, event dispatching, and detailed data retrieval within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the LeaveRequestDao instance responsible for database interactions related to leave requests.

methods.name: _changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a list of Leave objects, handling entitlement adjustments and ensuring proper status transition.

methods.name: _notifyLeaveStatusChange
methods.description: Dispatches appropriate events ('approve', 'cancel', 'reject') based on leave workflow action.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves allowed workflow actions based on employee, leave type, and current leave status.

methods.name: isLeaveRequestActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is permitted on a leave request given the current context.

methods.name: generateIncludeRolesForLeaveWorkflowByEmployee
methods.description: Determines roles to include in workflow actions based on whether the employee is viewing their own requests.

methods.name: generateLeaveStatusByLeaveType
methods.description: Generates a leave status string prefix for deleted leave types.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestActions
methods.description: Returns available actions for a leave request based on current status and permissions.

methods.name: changeLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a detailed leave request and dispatches corresponding events.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of a single leave and dispatches events.

methods.name: changeLeavesStatus
methods.description: Changes statuses for multiple leaves, grouping by leave request, and dispatches events accordingly.

methods.name: groupLeaves
methods.description: Groups a list of leaves by their parent leave request ID.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Retrieves detailed leave request objects, aggregating leaves belonging to each request.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsMap
methods.description: Creates a map of leave requests keyed by their ID for quick lookup.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Retrieves an associative array mapping leave status codes to their names.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Returns the name of a leave status given its numeric code.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Returns the numeric code for a given leave status name.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusesByNames
methods.description: Converts an array of leave status names into their corresponding codes.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Creates detailed leave representations for display or processing, given leaves and their parent leave request leaves.
